column3: “a day for blowing trumpets” renders “a day of teru’ah (loud blast)”; the Hebrew does not name trumpets, and “laborious work” renders “work of servitude” (throughout the chapter).
“one bull” renders “one young bull, a son of the herd” (also in verses 8, 13 and 36).
NASB supplies “of an ephah” (also in verses 9 and 14).
“having them without defect” renders “they shall be without defect for you.”
“a tenth for each” renders “a tenth, a tenth for the one” (also in verse 15).
“the sin offering of atonement” renders “the sin offering of the atonements.”
“observe a feast to the LORD” renders “celebrate a festival to the LORD.”
